name: SIM swap or number port before transfers
description: Mobile number is ported or SIM replaced shortly before one-time-passcode-protected actions or outbound transfers.
fp: Customers legitimately replace lost or upgraded phones.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
FATF, Recommendation 16 and Interpretive Note on payment transparency
UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
FinCEN, Advisory to Financial Institutions on Cyber-Events and Cyber-Enabled Crime (FIN-2016-A005, 2016)
FFIEC, Authentication and Access to Financial Institution Services and Systems (2021)

links.name: Wallet SIM swap followed by outbound transfers
links.ctx: Number is ported or SIM replaced, then funds drained to new payees.

links.name: SIM swap or number port detected
